caption_L1: This is a bar graph named Early voter turnout for the U.S. midterm elections by state , as of November 6 , 2018. The x-axis plots State. There is a linear scale of range 0 to 5,000,000 on the y-axis, marked Number of votes cast.
caption_L2L3: California, Florida and Texas have the biggest number of early voter turnouts. South Dakota has no early turnout voters at all. Several states had a very minimal early voter turnout, Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Mississippi, Rhode Island and Wyoming.
